Independently differentiated B in SymPy: B′=−1/8+τ(3+aτ)/(1+aτs)^2 and B′′=−2aτ²(3+aτ)/(1+aτs)^3<0. Thus its minimum lies at s=0 or 1, with B(0)=1/8−τ−e/2 and B(1)=2τ/(1+aτ)−e/2, giving the claimed necessary-and-sufficient strict window for THIS LOWER BOUND, not actual curvature. u∈[1,1+aτ] gives uniform certified k_hat≥ε⁴min(B0,B1)/(1+aτ)^2. The two branches cross at 1+(a−24)τ−8aτ²=0; checked closed positive root and small-a expansion τ*=1/24+a/864+a²/62208+O(a³) symbolically. Below crossing, derivative of lower branch has positive numerator 2+a e+a² e τ−4aτ on allowed range; above crossing first branch decreases while denominator grows. The source coefficient τ=1/24 is interior for every 0<ε≤1/4. Numerical samples at ε²=1/16 and 1/100 corroborate order; the inequalities are analytic.
